description: This file defines the code-behind for the 'TheorySet' web page in an online examination system. It includes event handlers for page load, course selection, question addition, exam setup, and navigation buttons, interacting with a SQL database to manage theories questions and course details.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Code-behind class for the online examination theory question management page, containing event handlers and database interaction logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load events. Currently has commented-out code, implying initialization actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course drop-down list based on the selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new theory question to the database, updates question number, and displays a confirmation alert.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Records exam details into the database and navigates back to the admin panel.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course drop-down list based on the selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Calculates and sets the next question number when a course is selected.
